newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Amgen eases.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Amgen eases.

text.p: Shares in biotechnology company Amgen Inc eased before Monday's market opening to stand out in quiet trading.
Traders described pre-opening markets as featureless ahead of U.S. data this week and the meeting of the rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee Tuesday and Wednesday.
"I'm not seeing anything really or active or moving so far," one said.

Amgen was trading at 58-3/4 from a Friday's close of 59-7/16. Traders said it was weighed by a Barron's newspaper article that said a recent spate of disappointing news meant "growth prospects are dimming for Amgen."
Stratasys Inc was trading at 21 from a Friday close of 21-3/4. The company reported early Monday it expected second-quarter revenues to be below analysts' estimates.
Cyanotech Corp eased to six from a closing price of 6-5/16 after it reported it expected its first-quarter sales and earnings to be lower than those of the same period last year.
Shares in JP Foodservice Co and Rykoff-Sexton Inc were flat. The companies announced early Monday they would merge.
Belco Oil & Gas Corp and Hugoton Energy Corp also had not moved. Belco said early Monday it had offered to buy Hugoton for $15 a share in a cash-stock deal.
